name: @wenathlan/cadria.sol
description: cadria theme Sol: the web theme of the video, image and 3D studio on the versawase engine. the deploy root owns its package so the vite build runs standalone (cd Sol && pnpm install && pnpm run build) and the vercel/netlify deploy roots resolve their toolchain. this package is NEVER published to npm, github packages or any registry - the published package is the central @wenathlan/cadria (app root). the interface sources are tsx/ts only: designs in tsx, logic in ts, zero js at the web root.
